name: KidCity: AI Attack
overview: Superstar vlogging family KidCity takes on a rogue AI named M1M1C in this all new Ryan and Friends Plus exclusive original series, KidCity: AI Attack by pocket.watch! Beck, Ava, and their parents must solve a series of cryptic clues to squash M1M1C's sinister plans to take over their channel and all of their subscribers' devices.
